verdict.rationale: Letta stores agent memory as plain Markdown files in a memory repository and shared memory as a Git repository, which implies a machine-readable, non-proprietary storage format (letta-docs-11, letta-docs-21), and self-hosting keeps data under the platform-engineer's control (letta-docs-30). However, there is no explicit documented 'export' or 'import' command/API for pulling memory out of Letta Cloud or migrating it elsewhere, and the OpenAPI/spec probe for such endpoints returned 404s (letta-probe-2). Missing for 10: an explicit export/import CLI or API command, documentation of a portable export format (e.g., JSON/YAML dump), and any independent confirmation that memory can be moved out of Letta Cloud without vendor tooling.
